entries.value: "`bsc config` (#168, request from the config-seed mirror #4251): read/adopt verbs for the desktop app's runtime config-seed mirror (~/.base-studio-code/config/). Before this, a file the app reported as DIVERGED from the packaged seed could be seen in the boot log but not acted on — the only remedy was deleting it by hand. Embeds its own copy of the CONFIG-ONLY subset of `src-tauri/data/` (same exclude list as the app's own embed) so this Tauri-free CLI can classify and diff against the packaged bytes without depending on the app crate."

lead: # GRAPH MATERIALIZATION, as a real build-dependency. A package gets exactly ONE build
# script and this crate already has its own, so the `build = "../graph-materialize/
# build.rs"` line the other adopters use is not available here — the shared file has to
# be CALLED instead. build.rs runs it as one more job.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
